description: Check up to 100 vendors (domains or company names) for ransomware leak-site claims in one call: per vendor, matching claims (group, dates, sources), claim count and groups. Raw claims only; use vendor_risk_report for risk levels, a summary and actions. Every result is an unverified claim from a criminal leak site, not a confirmed breach; found=false is not proof of absence. Fails (not charged) if the source is down for more than 25% of vendors. Read-only. Costs $0.50 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.

vendors.description: Vendor domains or company names, 1-100, e.g. ["acme.com", "Example Corp"]

name: bulk_vendor_check
